scope: Engineering proof from public examples and synthetic tests; not production qualification

steps.title: Source to fact to draft to review to controlled output
steps.evidence: 88 core checks and 47 repository/API checks, with saved source/fact/draft workflow.
steps.remaining: This is portfolio evidence, not commercial CMC experience or accepted submission content.

steps.title: Keep numbers, units, batch and source links
steps.evidence: 19 adversarial model/output checks; fixed IDs and bounded reviewer checks reject unsupported candidates.
steps.remaining: New methods, formats and customer documents need separate checks.

steps.title: Never guess a critical missing value
steps.evidence: Controlled synthetic conflict example remains HOLD; model output cannot approve or release.
steps.remaining: A human resolves actual scientific questions.

steps.title: Changed evidence makes downstream work stale
steps.evidence: 47 repository/API checks include revision permissions, audit chain and controlled branches.
steps.remaining: Customer review responsibilities must be assigned.

steps.title: Representative CMC case and controlled failure
steps.evidence: Drug X 100 mg immediate-release tablet work sample and conflicting SYN-A assay records.
steps.remaining: Customer data and qualified professional review are not replaced by the synthetic case.

steps.title: Compare expected answers and visible failures
steps.evidence: 19 adversarial checks and 7 compiled saved model-team checks.
steps.remaining: Qualified CMC/RA/QA review plus unseen authorized inputs remain pending.

steps.title: Use configured AI securely with permission and limits
steps.status: Live synthetic Groq and public Firecrawl check passed
steps.evidence: Four Groq model-role calls completed with a distinct reviewer; one public FDA Firecrawl retrieval succeeded. Exact saved receipts matched fresh GET readback on 2026-10-05.
steps.remaining: Customer-document quality, qualified review, vision capability and sustained availability still require separate proof.

steps.title: Accounts, saved work, audit and controlled output
steps.evidence: Separate role/account tests and persisted-workspace tests; no AI approval or automatic regulatory release.
steps.remaining: Production tenant tests and Google identity configuration are separate checks.

steps.title: Measure time and corrections honestly
steps.status: Measurement ready; real benefit not measured
steps.evidence: Model receipts record elapsed milliseconds and reported token usage. Synthetic test timings are engineering timings, not manual professional baselines.
steps.remaining: A qualified professional must do the same task manually and with assistance. No time-saving or accuracy percentage is claimed.

steps.title: Safe failures, recovery and operating checks
steps.evidence: Bounded retries, timeouts, duplicate prevention, role isolation and local recovery checks.
steps.remaining: A production backup restore, sustained load, alert delivery and incident drill still require the hosting/service operator.

liveProviderProof.scope: One live provider smoke using synthetic facts and one public FDA listing
